Questions

Why is my Wi-Fi slow only in some rooms?

Walls, distance and router position are the usual causes. We test each area and then move, add or change equipment where it actually helps.

Do I need to buy new equipment?

Not always. We check what you have first. If new gear is needed, we explain why in your quote before anything is bought.

Can you set up a separate network for guests or customers?

Yes. A guest network keeps visitors off your main devices and files.
